flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui components/datagrid/column/index (notice link), App.tsx route, pages/Notice/{mode/edit/EditView, detail/GroupPreview, detail/Overview, detail/OwnerDetails (+Hirer/Driver), detail/RdpAndDnDetails, detail/ANLetterDetail, detail/SuspensionDetail, detail/PaymentDetails}, utils/Meta/Notice. ocmsadminapi: list endpoints (validoffencenoticelist, offencenoticeownerdriverlist, suspendednoticelist, requestdriverparticularslist, drivernoticelist, anletterlist, notification-report/search) are only referenced through resources/api-authorization.properties. ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant
note: Clicking a notice number opens the detail page in a new tab with several categories (Overview, Offence Details, Owner/Hirer/Driver, Suspension, RDP and DN, Payment, LTA ROV, Summary). Notice, vehicle, owner/hirer/driver and payment data are complete. Gap: sent dates for letters exist only for RDP, DN, AN Letter and e-notification (other letter types have no list of their own), and the History tab for change history is commented out, so 'historical updates' are only partly visible through the suspension, payment and letter lists. The story text 'historICA/DOSl updates' looks like a typo and cannot be interpreted with certainty. Tickets used as context: OCMS-DF-2026-060 (Closed), OCMS-SR-2026-124/111 (ATOMS Flag source, already from VON in this repo), OCMS-DF-2026-116 (Closed, not on this table); none changes the verdict. PRD data content (for example notification-report): cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim the click-through, tab categories, notice/vehicle data and owner/hirer/driver data. Letter dates and history are claimed as partial. Ask URA which letters and history the story means

steps.step: Staff clicks a notice number in the result list and the notice detail page opens
steps.detail: The Notice No. column is a link (column/index.tsx:77) whose onClick calls PathNotice['VIEW'](value) and then window.open('#path', '_blank') (85-92), so the detail opens in a new tab. Route view/:notice_no/* maps to Notice.EditView (App.tsx:151). Note: ticket OCMS-DF-2026-116 (Closed) about a blank link concerned the 'Failed to TS Notices' list (FailedNoticesList), not this result table.

steps.step: The detail page shows information in several categories (tabs)
steps.detail: GroupPreview.tsx builds the Offence Info tabs: Overview, Offence Details, Owner/Hirer/Driver Details, Suspension Details, RDP and DN Details, Payment Details (60-121), then Offence Maintenance: LTA ROV, Summary, Apply Operation (139-181). EditView.tsx:52-98 loads data for the tab being opened (valid offence notice, notice detail, owner/driver/hirer, attachments, payment, refund). The separate eNotifications tab and Datahive are commented out (GroupPreview.tsx:123-126, 189-198); e-notification still exists inside the RDP and DN tab.

steps.step: Notice and vehicle detail: type, date/time, place, rule, processing status, payment status
steps.detail: Overview.tsx:110-200 shows current and next Processing Stage/Date, Suspension Type, Reason for Suspension, Due Date of Revival, Payment Status, Payment Date, Amount Payable and AN Flag; 244-300 shows Notice Type, Vehicle Registration Type, Vehicle No., Category, Offence Date/Time, Place and Computer Rule Code. PaymentDetails.tsx:62-100 shows Payment Flag and ATOMS Flag from VON (OCMS-SR-2026-124 and 111 concern the ATOMS Flag source; in this repo it already comes from NOTICE_VALID). OCMS-DF-2026-060 (Closed): the Reason for Suspension label for APP now separates TS-APP from PS-APP (Overview.tsx:57-77).

steps.step: Particulars of the vehicle owner, hirer and driver are shown
steps.detail: The Owner/Hirer/Driver Details tab (GroupPreview.tsx:89-100) renders OwnerDetails, HirerDetails and DriverDetails: name, ID No. and type, phone, email, address. Data is loaded from NOTICE_ODH (EditView.tsx:87, offencenoticeownerdriverlist) and addresses. For entities, Datahive (UEN) data is fetched in EditView.tsx:125-143 but its tab is commented out, so it is not visible on screen.

steps.step: Dates of letters and electronic notifications sent are shown
steps.detail: The RDP and DN Details tab holds sub-tabs RDP Details (dateOfRdp, line 79), DN Details (dateOfDn, 309), E-Notification Details (Send Date & Time, Mobile No/Email, error message, content; 553 onward) and AN Letter Details (dateOfAnLetter, ANLetterDetail.tsx:77); the sub-tab layout is in RdpAndDnDetails.tsx:680-691. Other letter types (for example reminder letters and Toppan letters) have no sent-date list of their own; they are only indirectly visible through Processing Date/Stage in Overview. The content of the notification-report/search data cannot be checked from this repo.

steps.step: Historical updates of the notice can be traced
steps.detail: The History tab (DatagridHistory/History) is commented out in GroupPreview.tsx:185-187 and Form.tsx:307-311, so there is no view of a notice's field-change history. What is visible: the Suspension Details list (suspendednoticelist, SuspensionDetail.tsx:93-98) as suspension history, Payment Details and refund, and the RDP/DN/AN/e-notification lists. The exact meaning of 'historICA/DOSl updates' in the story text is unclear (likely a typo): cannot verify from repo; judged as general notice history/updates.
